panels.title: Migration cutover readiness
panels.description: Fleet-wide readiness from a five-minute stability window. Missing, stale, or incomplete metrics are UNKNOWN.

targets.rawSql: WITH slot_window AS (SELECT time, dbname AS publisher, tag_data->>'migration_pair' AS migration_pair, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot, tag_data->>'database' AS database, COALESCE((data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint, 0) AS lag_bytes, COALESCE((data->>'active')::int, 0) AS active, COALESCE((data->>'publisher_streaming_count')::int, 0) AS streaming FROM source_replication_slot WHERE time >= now() - interval '5 minutes' AND COALESCE(tag_data->>'migration_pair', '') <> ''), slots AS (SELECT publisher, migration_pair, slot, (array_agg(database ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS database, (array_agg(lag_bytes ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS lag_bytes, min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen, bool_and(active = 1 AND streaming > 0) AS healthy, bool_and(lag_bytes = 0) AS lag_zero FROM slot_window GROUP BY publisher, migration_pair, slot), subscription_window AS (SELECT time, dbname AS subscriber, tag_data->>'migration_pair' AS migration_pair, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot, COALESCE((data->>'enabled')::int, 0) AS enabled, COALESCE((data->>'subscription_status')::int, -1) AS subscription_status, COALESCE((data->>'apply_worker_count')::int, 0) AS apply_workers FROM target_subscription WHERE time >= now() - interval '5 minutes' AND COALESCE(tag_data->>'migration_pair', '') <> ''), subscriptions AS (SELECT subscriber, migration_pair, subscription, slot, min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen, bool_and(enabled = 1 AND subscription_status = 1 AND apply_workers > 0) AS healthy FROM subscription_window GROUP BY subscriber, migration_pair, subscription, slot), error_points AS (SELECT time, dbname AS subscriber, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, COALESCE((data->>'apply_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS apply_errors, COALESCE((data->>'sync_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS sync_errors, COALESCE((data->>'stats_reset_epoch_s')::double precision, 0) AS reset_epoch FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE time >= now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_changes AS (SELECT *, greatest(apply_errors - lag(apply_errors) OVER error_order, 0) + greatest(sync_errors - lag(sync_errors) OVER error_order, 0) AS new_errors FROM error_points WINDOW error_order AS (PARTITION BY subscriber, subscription ORDER BY time)), errors AS (SELECT subscriber, subscription, min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen, COALESCE(sum(new_errors), 0)::bigint AS new_errors, min(reset_epoch) = max(reset_epoch) AS reset_stable FROM error_changes GROUP BY subscriber, subscription), table_window AS (SELECT time, dbname AS subscriber, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, COALESCE((data->>'total_tables')::bigint, 0) AS total_tables, COALESCE((data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint, 0) AS non_ready_tables FROM target_table_sync WHERE time >= now() - interval '5 minutes'), tables AS (SELECT subscriber, subscription, (array_agg(total_tables ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS total_tables, (array_agg(non_ready_tables ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS non_ready_tables, min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen, bool_and(total_tables > 0 AND non_ready_tables = 0) AS healthy FROM table_window GROUP BY subscriber, subscription), pairs AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.migration_pair, sub.migration_pair) AS migration_pair, s.publisher, sub.subscriber, COALESCE(s.slot, sub.slot) AS slot, sub.subscription, s.database, s.lag_bytes, s.first_seen AS source_first_seen, s.last_seen AS source_last_seen, s.healthy AS source_healthy, s.lag_zero, sub.first_seen AS target_first_seen, sub.last_seen AS target_last_seen, sub.healthy AS target_healthy FROM slots AS s FULL OUTER JOIN subscriptions AS sub ON sub.migration_pair = s.migration_pair AND sub.slot = s.slot), readiness AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.publisher, '?') || ' → ' || COALESCE(p.subscriber, '?') AS instance, COALESCE(p.database, '—') AS database, p.lag_bytes AS lag, e.new_errors AS errors, CASE WHEN t.last_seen IS NULL OR t.last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN t.total_tables > 0 AND t.non_ready_tables = 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS tables_ready, CASE WHEN p.publisher IS NULL OR p.subscriber IS NULL OR p.subscription IS NULL OR e.subscriber IS NULL OR t.subscriber IS NULL OR p.source_last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR p.target_last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR e.last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR t.last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR p.source_first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes' OR p.target_first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes' OR e.first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes' OR t.first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes' THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN p.source_healthy AND p.lag_zero AND p.target_healthy AND e.new_errors = 0 AND e.reset_stable AND t.healthy THEN 'READY' ELSE 'BLOCKED' END AS cutover_ready, p.publisher, p.subscriber, p.subscription, p.slot FROM pairs AS p LEFT JOIN errors AS e ON e.subscriber = p.subscriber AND e.subscription = p.subscription LEFT JOIN tables AS t ON t.subscriber = p.subscriber AND t.subscription = p.subscription) SELECT instance, database, lag, errors, tables_ready, cutover_ready, publisher, subscriber, subscription, slot FROM readiness ORDER BY CASE cutover_ready WHEN 'BLOCKED' THEN 0 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, instance, database
